entries.name: Jira
entries.prerequisite: An active Jira or Confluence site; tenant policy may require an administrator to approve the client.

entries.name: Airtable
entries.prerequisite: An Airtable account; enterprise administrators may need to allowlist the client.

entries.name: beehiiv
entries.prerequisite: A beehiiv account; the subscription plan controls available write capabilities.

entries.name: Bitly
entries.prerequisite: A Bitly account with either browser authorization or an API token.

entries.name: Candid
entries.prerequisite: A Candid account with access to the MCP connector.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.prerequisite: A Cloudflare account with access to the resources being connected.

entries.name: Cloudinary
entries.prerequisite: A Cloudinary account; authorization is limited by the signed-in user's roles.

entries.name: Coda
entries.prerequisite: A Coda account; the hosted MCP service is currently beta.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.prerequisite: A Hugging Face account.

entries.name: Kernel
entries.prerequisite: A Kernel account with either browser authorization or an API key.

entries.name: Local Falcon
entries.prerequisite: A Local Falcon account with MCP access.

entries.name: Make
entries.prerequisite: A Make account and access to the scenarios exposed to MCP.

entries.name: Manufact
entries.prerequisite: A Manufact account with MCP access.

entries.name: Miro
entries.prerequisite: A Miro account; enterprise administrators may restrict third-party MCP clients.

entries.name: Netlify
entries.prerequisite: A Netlify account with access to the relevant team and sites.

entries.name: Notion
entries.prerequisite: A Notion account and access to the pages or databases being shared.

entries.name: O'Reilly
entries.prerequisite: An O'Reilly Learning subscription with MCP or API access.

entries.name: PlanetScale
entries.prerequisite: A PlanetScale account; database and branch access are chosen during authorization.

entries.name: PostHog
entries.prerequisite: A PostHog account; personal API keys and optional organization or project pinning are supported as alternatives and advanced controls.

entries.name: Resend
entries.prerequisite: A Resend account with access to the relevant domains.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.prerequisite: A Sentry account with access to the relevant organizations and projects.

entries.name: TickTick
entries.prerequisite: A TickTick account with MCP access.

entries.name: Todoist
entries.prerequisite: A Todoist account.

entries.name: Webflow
entries.prerequisite: A Webflow account; workspace and site roles constrain accessible sites.

entries.name: Wix
entries.prerequisite: A Wix account with access to the relevant sites.

entries.name: Brex
entries.prerequisite: Brex early access and an administrator enabling the integration; financial actions require explicit approval.

entries.name: ClickHouse
entries.prerequisite: A ClickHouse Cloud ClickStack service and its service ID.

entries.name: Egnyte
entries.prerequisite: An eligible Egnyte plan and administrator approval for external LLM access.

entries.name: Embat
entries.prerequisite: An Embat account; pilot the connection because provider setup documentation is sparse.

entries.name: Mixpanel
entries.prerequisite: A Mixpanel account; the hosted MCP server is currently beta.

entries.name: Postman
entries.prerequisite: A Postman account; OAuth is available for US endpoints and API keys are required for EU endpoints.

entries.name: Razorpay
entries.prerequisite: A Razorpay account; financial or destructive actions always require explicit approval.

entries.name: Sanity
entries.prerequisite: A Sanity account with access to the relevant projects and datasets.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.prerequisite: A Stripe account; the server is public preview and payment actions require explicit approval.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.prerequisite: A Supabase account; use a development project and review write actions before connecting production data.

entries.name: Ticket Tailor
entries.prerequisite: A Ticket Tailor account; the provider may request an API key during its hosted authorization prompt.

entries.name: Asana
entries.prerequisite: Create an Asana MCP OAuth app and register Paperclip's callback URI; DCR is not supported.

entries.name: Box
entries.prerequisite: A Box administrator creates the OAuth integration and enables AI access.

entries.name: Mem0
entries.prerequisite: A Mem0 API key; the live server currently requires the slash-normalized endpoint.

entries.name: PagerDuty
entries.prerequisite: A PagerDuty API token; choose the regional endpoint that hosts the account.

entries.name: Similarweb
entries.prerequisite: A Similarweb subscription with API access and an API key.

entries.name: Xero
entries.prerequisite: Create a Xero OAuth app and confirm the applicable AI and data-use terms before connecting.

entries.name: Zapier
entries.prerequisite: Create a Zapier MCP server, choose the actions it exposes, and paste its generated connection URL.

entries.name: G2
entries.prerequisite: G2 must enable cross-application token introspection before an independently registered client can work.

entries.name: Vercel
entries.prerequisite: Vercel currently reviews and approves MCP clients.

entries.name: Zomato
entries.prerequisite: Zomato currently limits third-party clients and requires redirect-URI allowlisting.
